title: Robert Maxwell gatekeeping science via Pergamon Press

tellings.quote: And then you have Glenn Maxwell's father, Robert Maxwell, who's a triple agent, uh, MI6, KGB, Mossad, gatekeeping scientific discoveries through his control of journal publications via Pergaman Press.
Robert Maxwell’s work as a double agent for both MI6 and the KGB at the height of the Cold War made him very useful when, sometime in the late 1970s, he was also recruited by the Mossad.

Then, as a gatekeeper, he selectively suppressed or sequestered from the public sphere of establishment techno-scientific R&D any revolutionary and destabilizing information – including defense-related research with military applications.
It was also, not coincidentally, the location of the so-called “Throne of Satan” mentioned in the Book of Revelation

plain: Robert Maxwell, Ghislaine Maxwell's father, is said to have been a triple agent for MI6, the KGB and Israel's Mossad, and to have used his control of science journals through his company Pergamon Press to keep certain discoveries away from the public. The philosopher Jason Jorjani says this on the show, and his July 2025 piece Ocean Outlaw: A Portrait of Ghislaine Maxwell says Maxwell was a double agent for MI6 and the KGB before being recruited by the Mossad "sometime in the late 1970s", and that "as a gatekeeper, he selectively suppressed or sequestered" revolutionary research, "including defense-related research with military applications." The piece adds that the name had a darker echo, saying it was "not coincidentally" the location of the "Throne of Satan" in the Book of Revelation, apparently meaning the ancient city of Pergamon, and if the claim were true, one publisher could have held back breakthrough science.
